title: Discriminating experiment: Hall-only vs RF+Hall vs ECR+Hall on one common accelerator
status: DRAFT FOR DISCUSSION (IIST / professor), revision r2 (second-lens repair against execution branch e15f66f). Not pre-registered, not approved, no hardware committed. Every threshold, convention and decision rule in this file is PROPOSED for the owner (see proposed_register); nothing here is binding until the owner reconciles it with lane_06_experiment_protocol and lane_25_min_decisive_experiment.

premise.architecture_winner: NONE. The plan does not assume one and is designed so that each outcome discriminates between the hypotheses.
premise.p5_n2_validation_dependence: INDEPENDENT. The plan is valid whether or not any transport closure is ever admitted. It does not use any campaign result that is still running.
premise.hall_transport_status: Credible closure set = empty (CLAUDE.md, project decision 2026-09-26). P5-N2 v1 vacuum outcome: all nine screening candidates INCONCLUSIVE / NOT ELIGIBLE (hallthruster_bridge/validation/p5_n2_campaign_v1_vacuum_scores_report.md). This outcome is permanent and is not rewritten.
premise.consequence: The simulator cannot currently predict absolute Hall thrust, current or T/P_bus for any architecture. Accuracy requirements are therefore stated as discrimination rules tied to decision thresholds and to model uncertainty, not as invented numbers.

evidence_rules.numeric_values_in_this_file: Only values copied from repository files, each with its path. Every other threshold is 'TBD - requires <what>'. Nothing from memory is used as a requirement.
evidence_rules.evidence_level_of_results: Measurements on the actual Vyovrinda hardware at its operating condition = level 1. Measurements on an IIST laboratory thruster that is not the Vyovrinda design = level 2 or 3 depending on similarity (owner to classify). Within the validated operating domain of the tested hardware, these supersede literature-derived assumptions (EVIDENCE.md rule).
evidence_rules.no_tuning: Data from this experiment are never used to retune a transport closure. If they are used to test closures, the acceptance criteria are pre-registered and the measurements audited before any simulation is compared to them (CLAUDE.md promotion rule).

hypotheses.statement: At matched feed state, V_d and coil currents, powering an RF or ECR pre-ionizer does not improve thrust per bus power T/P_bus over Hall-only (the CLAUDE.md 'probably robust' finding that RF/helicon pre-ionisers add nothing, extended to ECR as a test).
hypotheses.status: mechanism-level model finding; untested on hardware

hypotheses.statement: Pre-ionization raises propellant utilization eta_u on N2 (and later air-like mixtures) enough that T/P_bus increases despite the pre-ionizer bus power.
Pre-ionization lowers the minimum feed pressure / mass flow at which the Hall discharge ignites and sustains (startup and low-density operability), independent of any T/P_bus change.
Ions produced upstream are largely lost in the interstage (wall recombination, potential barrier), so source ionization does not reach the Hall channel.
hypotheses.status: model assumption to be measured (Interstage class)

hypotheses.statement: Pre-ionization changes the discharge stability (breathing-mode amplitude/frequency, sustainment window in V_d and coil current).
Pre-ionization shifts the ion species mix (N+ vs N2+) and/or the species acceleration voltage (ionization/birth location), relevant to the non-gating E x B physics-forensics lane.
hypotheses.status: hypothesis; P5-N2 E x B diagnostic (V_a(N+) far below measured in the model) is non-gating forensics only

hypotheses.statement: The ECR stage's own magnetic field (0.0875 T resonance at 2.45 GHz) perturbs the Hall B(z) in the channel, so ECR+Hall is not the same accelerator as Hall-only unless compensated.
Any benefit of RF+Hall or ECR+Hall exists only within a feed-pressure window (below the pre-ionizer p_min the source does not couple; above some pressure Hall-only already ionizes well).
hypotheses.status: hypothesis; model encodes it via p_min gates

key_experiment.principle: One Hall accelerator (same channel, anode/gas distributor, magnetic circuit, cathode, thrust stand, facility, feed line). Only the upstream ionization stage is switched. Every comparison is a within-session PAIRED difference so that stand calibration, facility pressure effects and hardware ageing largely cancel.

modes.name: MODE_PREIONIZER_REMOVED
modes.description: Pre-ionizer hardware absent; feed enters the Hall anode through the reference feed line.

modes.name: MODE_INSTALLED_UNPOWERED
modes.description: RF or ECR stage installed and unpowered. For an electromagnet ECR circuit: magnets de-energized. For a PERMANENT-MAGNET ECR circuit the field cannot be switched off, so M0b = M0c for that hardware and H6 (field perturbation) cannot be separated by switching the magnets; it is then isolated only by M0 vs M0b (which confounds field and conductance) plus measured B(z) in both states, and optionally a re-trimmed Hall coil condition (D7). Control that separates geometry/conductance/neutral-pressure effects of the hardware from plasma effects. M0 vs M0b difference must be measured before attributing any M1/M2 effect to pre-ionization.

modes.name: MODE_INSTALLED_ECR_MAGNETS_ON
modes.description: ECR stage installed, microwave off, ECR magnets on (electromagnet circuit only; identical to M0b for a permanent-magnet circuit). Isolates the magnetic-field perturbation (H6) from the ionization effect.

modes.name: MODE_RF_POWERED
modes.description: RF pre-ionizer powered; power level swept.

modes.name: MODE_ECR_POWERED
modes.description: ECR pre-ionizer powered; power level swept.

key_experiment.run_order: Randomized/interleaved mode order within a session with a return to M0b between blocks to measure drift; each set point approached from both directions (up/down in V_d, flow and pre-ionizer power) to detect hysteresis. Repeated sessions on different days to separate day-to-day variability from mode effects.
key_experiment.ignition_and_sustainment_protocol: For each mode and gas: decreasing-flow (and decreasing feed-pressure) sweep at fixed V_d until extinction, then increasing until re-ignition; record both thresholds and the ignition transient (I_d trace). Cold-start ignition attempts counted (successes/attempts). Sustainment window in V_d at fixed flow (cf. P5-N2 text: unsustainable above ~275 V / below 225 V, hallthruster_bridge/identification/p5_n2_measurement_audit_findings_v1.json F4).

measurements.quantity: discharge current I_d: DC mean and time trace
measurements.instrument: shunt/Hall-effect current probe, bandwidth sufficient to resolve the breathing mode (TBD - requires expected frequency band for this geometry)

measurements.instrument: thrust stand with in-situ calibration, zero-drift record, cold-flow tare for each gas and mode
measurements.gap_it_closes: ECHT publishes no total thrust uncertainty or N2 cold-flow tare (echt_n2_evidence_audit_v1.json gap register)

measurements.quantity: component power on the bus_power_boundary_v1 basis: for each v1 component (hall_discharge, hall_magnet, cathode_keeper, cathode_heater, flow_control, compressor, thermal_control, housekeeping; plus rf_source for rf_hall, ecr_source and ecr_magnet for ecr_hall) the time-averaged power at its LOAD-SIDE REFERENCE PLANE, as defined in docs/architecture_comparison/power_boundary/BUS_POWER_BOUNDARY.md section 3. For rf_source / ecr_source that plane is the net RF / microwave power (forward - reflected) at the coil/antenna feed terminals or coupling-structure input (m_Prf).
measurements.instrument: multi-channel DC power analyzer / calibrated shunt-divider pairs at each DC load plane, simultaneous sampling; directional coupler at the source load plane (m_Prf)
measurements.mandatory_field: P_bus (PARTIAL until the compressor term is supplied; see below)
measurements.basis_single: ONE basis for every component including the pre-ionizers: P_bus = sum_c P_load,c / eta_c via bus_power_ledger(arch, loads, efficiencies) (abep_sim/arch_boundary.py), with eta_c the pre-registered ledger efficiency, identical in all arms for the common components. No laboratory converter or generator efficiency enters T/P_bus, and no model PPU loss is added on top of a lab DC input (that would double-count conversion). This follows the boundary contract of lane_11_bus_boundary and the bus basis of lane_25_min_decisive_experiment section 5.
measurements.lab_dc_input: The DC input of each laboratory supply and generator is ALSO recorded, but only as efficiency evidence: eta_lab = P_load / P_DC,in at the operating point (evidence for the ledger efficiency, evidence class 'measured' for lab hardware, not flight). A secondary lab-basis ratio may be reported, labelled LAB_CHAIN, never as a bus_power_boundary_v1 result. Rationale: charging the rf_hall / ecr_hall arms at non-flight laboratory generator efficiency would bias the comparison toward H0, the hypothesis under test.
measurements.compressor: ABSENT_IN_LAB in every mode: the laboratory feed starts at the valve outlets, so no compressor exists. The compressor row is carried explicitly as unavailable from E1 and is RECONSTRUCTED from the upstream ICD (compressor bus draw at the delivered total flow and composition of the point; evidence class 'reconstructed', with ICD revision and uncertainty), as in lane_06_experiment_protocol section 5. It is never a placeholder and never zero.
measurements.totals: P_bus,lab = sum over the components measured in E1 (compressor excluded) is a PARTIAL_BOUNDARY total and is labelled PARTIAL_BOUNDARY wherever it appears. P_bus,v1 = P_bus,lab + P_compressor,ICD only when the ICD supplies it; otherwise P_bus,v1 is UNAVAILABLE. A common additive term does not cancel in paired ratios, so partial-boundary ratios are never reported as bus_power_boundary_v1 ratios. Common loads the lab hardware does not represent (flow_control, housekeeping, thermal_control of flight hardware) are ledger inputs with their evidence class, identical across arms (lane_25_min_decisive_experiment section 5).
measurements.rule: Never substitute forward or absorbed RF/microwave power at a non-load plane, or Hall discharge power alone, for P_bus (CLAUDE.md bus_power_boundary_v1 definition). Reflected power is used only to form net load-plane power.
measurements.open_reconciliation: lane_06_experiment_protocol books rf_source / ecr_source at the generator DC input (rf_generator_input / microwave_source_input); lane_25_min_decisive_experiment and the lane_11_bus_boundary contract book them at the load plane plus ledger efficiency. This package follows the contract (load plane); the owner reconciles lane_06_experiment_protocol (see lane_25_min_decisive_experiment section 13).

derived_metrics.definition: T / P_bus on the bus_power_boundary_v1 ledger basis (m_Pbus). Reported on two labelled bases: PARTIAL_BOUNDARY (P_bus,lab) and V1 (P_bus,lab + P_compressor,ICD, only when the ICD supplies it). Only the V1 basis is a common-boundary result.

paired difference (M1 or M2) - M0b at matched conditions, per comparison basis and per power basis (PARTIAL_BOUNDARY / V1); M0b - M0 reported separately. Equivalent log-ratio form ln R_arch as in lane_25_min_decisive_experiment section 3 (owner chooses the governing form).

species-resolved: sum over ions of (I_beam * Omega_i / q_i) * m_i / (e * mdot_anode), with I_beam from the Faraday sweep and Omega_i from E x B; for N2 reported on a nitrogen-atom (mass) basis so that dissociation is not double counted. Cathode-gas ions excluded or reported separately.
mean species acceleration voltage (RPA / E x B, V_p corrected) / V_d
from the Faraday divergence sweep; consistency check against T, I_beam, species and V_a (closure of the thrust decomposition)
difference in minimum sustaining flow / feed pressure between modes
region in (mdot, V_d, coil current, pre-ionizer power) where I_d oscillation amplitude/mean is below a threshold
derived_metrics.threshold: TBD - requires a PPU / stability requirement from the power subsystem (owner)

derived_metrics.definition: ion current delivered to the Hall anode region / ion current leaving the source
P_bus - (P_jet + wall/thermal loss + supply losses + radiated); reported, not forced to close
derived_metrics.note: mirrors the architecture ledger gate (< 2 % residual in the model); experimental closure uncertainty to be stated

accuracy_requirements.principle: Accuracy is specified by what must be distinguishable, not by a target number chosen in advance. The decisive quantities are paired differences between modes, so the requirement applies to the uncertainty of the DIFFERENCE, including run-to-run repeatability and drift, not only to single-instrument accuracy.

rules.requirement: The uncertainty of the paired difference must be small enough that the decision threshold delta_req (the break-even gain at which the pre-ionizer's added bus power, mass, thermal load and complexity are repaid) is resolvable; proposed: expanded uncertainty (k=2) < delta_req/2 so a mid-band outcome is not ambiguous.
rules.delta_req: TBD - requires lane_28_break_even surfaces on bus_power_boundary_v1 (lane_11_bus_boundary) with lane_15_thermal_life and the mass BOM of lane_21_mass_bom. The factor 1/2 and k=2 are proposed conventions (owner decision), superseded by the multiplicity-corrected convention if the owner adopts lane_25_min_decisive_experiment's.

rules.requirement: Resolve the eta_u change that would make T/P_bus cross delta_req, given the measured P_bus increase; i.e. sigma(delta eta_u) derived from R1 through T ~ mdot * eta_u * v_i (model-derived propagation, stated with the propagation used).
rules.value: TBD - derived from R1 once delta_req exists

rules.requirement: Flow and feed-pressure resolution finer than the gap between the Hall-only threshold and the lowest feed state the Vyovrinda intake/compressor can deliver in the RFP altitude range (180-230 km, CLAUDE.md RFP envelope).
rules.value: TBD - requires the lane_16_feed_envelope delivered feed envelope and upstream ICD IF-A5

rules.metric: I_d, T (for transport-closure testing on our hardware)
rules.requirement: Measurement uncertainty smaller than the spread of predictions across the transport closures being discriminated, and no worse than the literature uncertainties that already limited P5 (P5-N2: thrust sigma 2.6 mN, I_d from P_d at 3 significant figures with no stated I_d uncertainty; blind I_d criterion 15 % was missed at Xe2 by -15.56 %). Sources: hallthruster_bridge/identification/p5_n2_measurement_audit_findings_v1.json; CLAUDE.md next-work item 1.
rules.value: spread across closures on our geometry: TBD - requires an admitted credible set (currently empty) or an owner-approved non-design sensitivity study; screening candidates never produce design Hall maps

rules.requirement: Uncertainty small enough to decide whether the N+ vs N2+ acceleration-voltage ordering is reproduced and whether pre-ionization moves it (H5). Reference only: P5-N2 E x B V_a sigma 11.6 V (literature, far field).

Every load-plane power channel (m_Pbus, m_Prf) sampled simultaneously; the uncertainty of P_bus on the ledger basis (including the ledger-efficiency bounds and, on the V1 basis, the ICD compressor uncertainty) must not dominate R1.

Session-to-session repeatability of M0b (return points) must be quantified and included in every paired-difference uncertainty; a mode effect smaller than M0b drift is reported as unresolved, not as zero.

accuracy_requirements.convention_status: PROPOSED. Two conventions exist in merged drafts: this package's R1 (single comparison, expanded uncertainty k=2 < delta_req/2 on the paired difference) and lane_25_min_decisive_experiment section 6 (ln R_arch classified against a PROPOSED +/-5 % band with simultaneous Student-t intervals at Welch-Satterthwaite dof, m = 14 comparisons, k = 3.1727; lane_06_experiment_protocol uses HIGHER/LOWER/NOT_DISTINGUISHED with Holm step-down). This package does NOT claim to govern: for a pre-registered run the lane_25_min_decisive_experiment simultaneous-interval convention (or whatever the owner adopts on reconciliation) governs, and R1 is then read as the discussion-level statement 'the interval must be narrow enough to resolve delta_req', with the multiplicity-corrected coverage factor replacing k=2.

decision_logic.outcome: delta_T_over_Pbus(M1 or M2) resolvably > +delta_req at matched mdot and V_d, within the delivered feed envelope, on the V1 power basis (a PARTIAL_BOUNDARY-only result is reported but is not decisive)
decision_logic.supports: H1 for that pre-ionizer; CONDITIONAL_BASELINE candidacy for rf_hall or ecr_hall within the tested envelope
decision_logic.does_not_establish: absolute flight performance, life, or ABEP closure

decision_logic.outcome: |delta_T_over_Pbus| < delta_req (resolved, V1 basis) and no ignition-threshold shift
decision_logic.supports: H0; hall_only as the simpler conditional baseline
decision_logic.refutes: H1 and H2 for that pre-ionizer within the tested envelope

decision_logic.outcome: delta_T_over_Pbus resolvably < 0 (pre-ionizer costs more than it returns) but ignition/sustainment threshold resolvably lower
decision_logic.supports: H2 without H1: the pre-ionizer is a startup/low-density enabler, not a performance improver
decision_logic.decision: no winner; the choice depends on whether the delivered feed state falls below the Hall-only threshold (lane_16_feed_envelope, lane_28_break_even); consider duty-cycled pre-ionization as a separate engineering question

decision_logic.outcome: eta_u rises but T/P_bus falls or is unchanged
decision_logic.supports: ionization cost in the source exceeds the acceleration gain; points to source coupling or interstage loss
decision_logic.next: use m_Prf and m_Iion_interstage to attribute to coupling vs transport

decision_logic.outcome: interstage-delivered ion current is a small fraction of the source ion current
decision_logic.refutes: architecture-model assumption of efficient interstage transport (Interstage class) for that geometry
decision_logic.decision: no architecture conclusion until an interstage redesign is tested; do not attribute to the Hall accelerator
all M1/M2 effects are referenced to M0b, not M0; report the installation penalty separately (it is a real cost of the architecture)

decision_logic.outcome: M0c differs resolvably from M0b (ECR magnets alone change I_d, T or B(z))
decision_logic.decision: ecr_hall is a different accelerator field; compare at re-matched B(z) (coil re-trim) as an additional pre-declared condition, and report both

decision_logic.outcome: stability envelope changes (wider/narrower sustainment window; oscillation amplitude change)
decision_logic.decision: feeds lane_24_hard_gates only if a mode cannot be operated stably anywhere in the delivered feed envelope

decision_logic.outcome: a mode cannot ignite or sustain anywhere in the delivered feed envelope, repeatably
decision_logic.decision: ELIMINATED_WITHIN_TESTED_ENVELOPE for that architecture only through lane_24_hard_gates (demonstrated hard gate), never extrapolated beyond the tested envelope

decision_logic.outcome: species mix or species V_a shifts with pre-ionization
decision_logic.decision: non-gating: feeds the E x B physics-forensics lane; never used for tuning

decision_logic.outcome: all differences below resolution (R7 drift dominates)
decision_logic.decision: UNRESOLVED; report as such; improve repeatability before repeating; do not read as H0

transport_identifiability_measurements.context: P5-Xe transport is not uniquely identifiable; P5-N2 v1 left all candidates INCONCLUSIVE (66 % of run-readings out of chemistry domain). The gaps below are the ones recorded in the repository. On our own hardware they can be closed by measurement (level 1), which removes layer-1 nuisance that literature cannot.

ECHT: measured B only at 2 A; '130 G' is FEMM at 3 A (echt_n2/README.md)

transport_identifiability_measurements.use_rule: If these data are used to test transport closures, (1) audit measurements and uncertainties, (2) pre-register acceptance criteria, (3) then simulate; never retune; validation modes (vacuum / facility) are never crossed.

cannot_yet_be_claimed: Any absolute Hall result from the 0-D closure (v1.2-v1.6): ABEP thrust, 2.5 kW closure, 110-120 kg, ECR+Hall P(success) 0.77 vs 0.63 - WITHDRAWN (CLAUDE.md).
Historical sweep statements such as 'ECR+Hall closes on physics' / '12 ABEP-closed' / 'P(closed) 3-5 %' (docs/HISTORY.md v0.2.1, v0.3) - superseded 0-D closure; not quotable.
v1.3 Hall hysteresis / low-mode collapse - numerical artefact.
Any admitted Hall transport closure: credible set is empty; no design Hall maps exist.
Any architecture winner or demonstrated ABEP closure (drag compensation) for Hall-only, RF+Hall or ECR+Hall.
Gate-4 cross-family mission UQ absolute numbers (conditional on gate 3, which FAILS).
Any outcome of running O4 staged sensitivities, escalations or facility runs (not stated here).
That P5-N2 v1 could be rescored to PASS: the v1 outcome stays INCONCLUSIVE permanently.
That ECHT-N2 is an independent scoreable validation dataset (echt_n2/README.md: not without forced assumptions).
Model-derived P5-N2 quantities Phi_m,n, eta_SP,n, xi_N as measurements.
can_be_stated_as_probably_robust: Grids are life-limited by CEX plus the perveance window (mechanism-level, CLAUDE.md).
Magnetic nozzles are excluded by energy per particle even at the energy bound (mechanism-level, CLAUDE.md).
RF/helicon pre-ionisers add nothing (mechanism-level model finding, CLAUDE.md) - this is hypothesis H0, which E1 tests on hardware.

questions_for_iist_discussion: Facility: pumping speed and background pressure at N2 flows of interest; gauge locations; RGA availability.
Thrust stand: resolution, calibration method, thermal drift at multi-hour runs.
Diagnostics available: E x B probe, RPA, Faraday probe (guard ring, polar arm), Langmuir probes, high-bandwidth current probes, Hall-probe B mapping.
Existing Hall thruster: can its magnetic circuit and anode accept an upstream RF or ECR stage without changing the channel? Is an ECR stage (2.45 GHz, 875 G resonance) available or buildable?
Cathode: type, gas, whether it can run on N2 or must run on Xe/Ar (affects species attribution).
Gas handling: N2 and N2/O2 compatibility of flow controllers, cathode and walls; oxygen safety.
Which of M0/M0b/M0c/M1/M2 are feasible first; minimum viable subset.
Data-sharing terms so that raw traces and per-point data can be published or archived with provenance.

A_conditional_selection.supports: Measured, paired, common-boundary (V1 basis) differences and threshold shifts per architecture and condition, enough for 'architecture X is baseline provided conditions ... are demonstrated' (D1-D3, with the break-even source-chain efficiency as a condition since flight generators are not tested). Does not need Physics Baseline 1.0.
A_conditional_selection.needs: delta_req from lane_28_break_even; feed envelope (lane_16_feed_envelope, ICD IF-A5); ledger efficiencies and the ICD compressor draw (V1 basis); owner reconciliation of conventions with lane_25_min_decisive_experiment / lane_06_experiment_protocol; hardware and facility (section 10 questions).

B_physics_backed_selection.supports: Transport-independent source data (load-plane source power, interstage delivered current, species) and Hall identifiability data on the tested hardware (measured B(z) with coil currents, as-built geometry, I_d traces, per-point divergence, species fractions).
B_physics_backed_selection.blocked_by: No admitted Hall transport closure (credible set empty, gate 3 FAIL); O/O2 chemistry not done (CLAUDE.md next work 4); any use of E1 data as promotion evidence needs its own audit and pre-registration before measurement; the second lens required for single-lens-v1 lanes.

C_proposal_PDR_freeze.supports: Measured load-plane power per consumer, lab source-chain efficiency as ledger evidence, component temperatures (Q_reject estimate), ignition statistics.
C_proposal_PDR_freeze.needs: Integrated mass (lane_21_mass_bom), thermal and life (lane_15_thermal_life, docs/evidence/wall_life/), cathode (lane_19_cathode_integration), flight-representative PPU and generator efficiencies, mission closure. E1 alone does not support C; flight life is unavailable from it.

prior_evidence.citation: A. Shabshelowitz, A. D. Gallimore, P. Y. Peterson, 'Performance of a Helicon Hall Thruster Operating with Xenon, Argon, and Nitrogen', J. Propulsion and Power 30(3):664-671 (2014), doi:10.2514/1.B35041
prior_evidence.access: metadata via Crossref API (api.crossref.org/works/10.2514/1.B35041) and abstract via OpenAlex API, accessed 2026-09-26; full text not accessed (abstract only)
prior_evidence.abstract_statement: Single- and two-stage operation measured on xenon, argon and nitrogen (nitrogen at 200 V); during two-stage operation thrust marginally increased with RF power while propulsive efficiency and thrust-to-power both decreased; probe diagnostics suggest a slight increase in propellant efficiency insufficient to overcome the added power.
prior_evidence.relevance: Published hardware precedent for H0 vs H1 on an RF (helicon) pre-ionizer including N2, and a reason delta_req must be resolvable. Evidence class: measured (literature, different hardware; level per docs/EVIDENCE.md is owner-classified). Numeric flow rates and the basis on which RF power was counted (DC input vs forward) are not recovered from the abstract: verify before any quantitative use.
